status: Exploratory retrospective study; all available historical periods have been inspected in earlier research. No untouched-test or prospective claim.
model: Normalized finite fractional-integral weights on squared standardized return innovations; implicit graph diffusion; positive intercept and feedback below one.
parameter_selection: Pooled normalized one-step QLIKE on trailing validation; scale/correlation fitted strictly before validation, then refit on observed history. No outer-target selection.
primary_score: Normalized QLIKE against summed squared returns centered at the common origin-fitted mean; compare all methods on identical origins.
inference: Paired circular block bootstrap 2000 replicates, blocks 5 and 10 origins, entire asset panel resampled together; nominal intervals, no family-wise significance claim.
mean_scope: Risk/variance forecasts; no claim of directional price-prediction improvement.
